classification_note: 本库人工整理的表达方式标签，不是任何会议期刊的官方绘图规范；配色为绘制建议，未从每张原图精确取色。

layouts.name: 线性流水线
layouts.definition: 单条主链横向或纵向推进，输入、变换与输出顺序清楚。
layouts.use_when: 输入到输出的顺序方法、数据处理、推理流程。
layouts.avoid_when: 把真正并行的模态硬挤成一条链。
layouts.prompt_clause: Use one aligned main pipeline with consistent module sizes; show each transformation in reading order. Route auxiliary links outside the main chain.

layouts.name: 多分支与汇合
layouts.definition: 多条并行编码/处理支路，明确融合、共享或分叉节点。
layouts.use_when: 多模态、双编码器、教师学生、多个任务头。
layouts.avoid_when: 支路交叉或共享模块语义不清。
layouts.prompt_clause: Use parallel aligned lanes for the branches, explicit merge/split nodes and a clearly labelled fusion operation. Keep shared and branch-specific modules distinct.

layouts.name: 层级编码解码
layouts.definition: 按层级、分辨率或网络深度排列，跨层联系与跳连可见。
layouts.avoid_when: 没有层级意义却使用复杂U形。
layouts.prompt_clause: Arrange the network by depth or resolution; align corresponding encoder/decoder levels. Route skip connections in reserved gutters and distinguish add from concat when supplied.

layouts.name: 模块总览与局部放大
layouts.definition: 外层方法总览加子模块容器/插图，建立整体到细节的层级。
layouts.use_when: 复杂总体框架与一个核心创新模块。
layouts.avoid_when: 各插图同等拥挤、放大框与总图没有对应。
layouts.prompt_clause: Create a clear overview and one or two bounded detail insets. Repeat module identifiers to connect overview and detail; group boundaries must not look like data-flow arrows.

layouts.name: 节点关系与消息传递
layouts.definition: 显式节点与边，邻居、关系类型或聚合目标以位置/颜色区分。
layouts.use_when: GNN、知识图谱、因果DAG、关系推理。
layouts.avoid_when: 把模块之间所有箭头都叫消息传递。
layouts.prompt_clause: Draw explicit node-link graphs with visible adjacency and relation labels where required. Distinguish internal illustrative graph edges from directed system-flow arrows; highlight the target node and aggregation only if specified.

layouts.name: token矩阵与算子展开
layouts.definition: 用token条、矩阵、张量或离散序列展现操作过程。
layouts.use_when: 注意力、mask、patch、索引编码与张量机制。
layouts.avoid_when: 将概念矩阵画成带数值结果的统计热图。
layouts.prompt_clause: Use token strips, tensor tiles and operator nodes to expose the computation. Preserve supplied tensor dimensions and sequence order; schematic colors encode roles, not fabricated measurements.

layouts.name: 迭代与反馈回路
layouts.definition: 重复步骤、训练更新或环境交互以回路/时间箭头表达。
layouts.use_when: 扩散逆过程、优化更新、RL、工具循环。
layouts.avoid_when: 给只读检索系统添加不存在的回答回写。
layouts.prompt_clause: Make iteration direction and the repeated unit explicit. Route feedback outside the forward path; draw a loop only when the supplied edge list contains it. Separate interaction, learning and control links.

layouts.name: 分阶段泳道
layouts.definition: 离线/在线、训练/推理、客户端/服务端等按容器分轨。
layouts.use_when: RAG离线在线、训练测试、系统分层工作流。
layouts.avoid_when: 把分组边界当连线或将阶段混在同一轨。
layouts.prompt_clause: Use labelled stage or responsibility swimlanes. Align chains within each lane and route cross-lane links through a clear gutter. Stage containers are grouping devices; cross-stage read/write directions must follow the brief.

layouts.name: 多面板机制对照
layouts.definition: 以(a)(b)等面板对照结构或机制变化，保留相同基准位置。
layouts.use_when: 基线与新方法、不同阶段、不同机制设计。
layouts.avoid_when: 用实验结果曲线替代机制对照。
layouts.prompt_clause: Use comparable panels with aligned input/output positions and consistent visual vocabulary. Emphasize structural differences with one accent color; panels compare mechanisms, not invented numerical performance.

layouts.name: 概念示意与场景隐喻
layouts.definition: 图标、人物、物体或几何场景解释任务、概念与动作。
layouts.use_when: 任务动机、具身环境、科学机制直观说明。
layouts.avoid_when: 装饰场景代替算法结构或暗示无根据的生物因果。
layouts.prompt_clause: Use a restrained explanatory scene or a few consistent icons, connected to the stated mechanism. Keep illustration subordinate to scientific meaning; do not add decorative characters or new claims.

layouts.name: 树状层级与路由
layouts.definition: 自顶向下层次、树节点、搜索路径或分层服务栈。
layouts.use_when: 层次池化、树检索、任务路由、系统栈。
layouts.avoid_when: 把一般DAG误画成只能有单父节点的树。
layouts.prompt_clause: Use a clear hierarchy with aligned levels and labelled parent-child or routing relations. Preserve multiple parents if the supplied structure is a DAG; do not force it into a tree.

visuals.name: 扁平柔和色块
visuals.definition: 白底、低饱和模块填充、细描边、少量圆角。
visuals.prompt_clause: Flat academic vector-like appearance on white; muted blue, green, lavender and amber functional groups; thin consistent dark-slate outlines; no shadows or gradients.

visuals.name: 单色细线
visuals.definition: 黑白/灰色线稿，通过边框与线型区分语义。
visuals.prompt_clause: Monochrome line art with white and light-gray fills, crisp black/gray outlines and high legibility. Encode distinctions by labels and shapes rather than color alone.

visuals.name: 张量层叠与轻透视
visuals.definition: 特征图、张量或网络层以堆叠片、薄立方体和轻透视表达。
visuals.prompt_clause: Represent supplied feature maps or tensors as thin stacked slabs with restrained consistent isometric perspective. Keep labels flat and legible; avoid glossy rendering, lighting effects or gratuitous depth.

visuals.name: 图标场景与框图混合
visuals.definition: 输入样例/场景/图标与模块框图并置，明确图示角色。
visuals.prompt_clause: Combine clean flat process blocks with a small number of restrained explanatory icons or input-scene thumbnails. Keep a consistent illustration language and ample whitespace; scene content is schematic unless a real input is provided.

visuals.name: 彩色节点关系图
visuals.definition: 彩色节点和细边，以颜色表示节点角色或关系种类。
visuals.prompt_clause: Use muted colored circular nodes and fine neutral graph edges; reserve one stronger accent for the target or active neighborhood. Provide labels or a compact legend for semantic node roles, without fabricating graph measurements.

visuals.name: 高对比模块强调
visuals.definition: 较强色彩区分路径或新增模块；保持有限颜色。
visuals.prompt_clause: Use a limited high-contrast palette for major branches, with a single accent highlighting the stated contribution. Keep the background white and text dark; avoid neon, glow and visual clutter.
